notes.title: Bugs fixes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932626/0116e308d225059f7b10f3a8d370dcf613c4459e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello 3D platforming fans![/h1]

A huge [b]thanks to everyone who's spent their hard earned cash on the game[/b] so far. We are really enjoying seeing everyone play the game and all the awesome feedback that has generated. The game is going to benefit greatly from this so keep it up!

This first patch focuses on a number of game breaking bugs that a few of you encountered. The following bugs have been addressed and should be fixed as of today's update.

[b]* Bug in the swimming collision that caused players to get stuck at waters edge.
* Activating the hatch (by collecting 100 fragments) during a minigame level loading loop.
* Getting hit while activating a shrine caused a hang.
* Infinite falls in areas of level 1 (no fall volume)
* Main timer not reset and instadeath upon gameover \ restart
* Game over screen indicated wrong file loading.[/b]

Special thanks to [b]Mazion on Twitch[/b] & [b]Temmie Plays on Youtube[/b] for the bug reports!

Over the next little while we'll be working to address a few issues in the progression balancing, fix lower priority bugs and add some requested features such as a drop shadow underneath the player. Watch for future updates!

Reach us for support via email here: support@exitearth.com

Thanks everyone,
Randall

notes.title: Welcome Everyone!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932626/733aab37cdd76ae5044eb4a5ccd23d97445c33cf.jpg[/img]

[h1]Early Access launch has arrived... Welcome one and all![/h1]

First of all I want to welcome anyone new to the game and thank everyone who's helped us get this far. While I've been a professional developer of games for the last 20 years, the transition to indie and the strains that come with it have been a massive undertaking. Today's launch is made possible by the continued support and enthusiasm we've received from both our community and fellow developers. You guys are awesome!

Our first order of business during our launch window will be making sure that people who have bought the game are not encountering any issues that stop them from booting up and playing. Hopefully there won't be too many people that fall into this category and if you do, thank you in advance for your patience while we work towards a resolution. We'll be watching the discussion boards and you can additionally reach us via email here: support@exitearth.com

During the coming weeks we'll be working to iron out any frustrating issues in progression that our players are encountering. We encourage your feedback on such issues via the discussion boards. Past that we'll be laying out our road map for the game towards version 1.0 and any additional content that comes with it.

Once again thank you all for your support. It means a whole to to us!

Take care,
Randall
